organization_urn.description: The LinkedIn organization page the counts belong to, as a URN of the form `urn:li:organization:{id}`.

organic_follower_count.description: Followers in this segment; for these demographic facets LinkedIn rolls organic and paid followers into this one count.

paid_follower_count.description: Paid followers in this segment; LinkedIn says not to read it for the demographic facets, whose totals are in `organic_follower_count`.

organization_urn.description: The LinkedIn organization page the counts belong to, as a URN of the form `urn:li:organization:{id}`.

time_range_start.description: Start of the day the gains are counted for, inclusive; the connector asks LinkedIn for one row per day.

time_range_end.description: End of that day, exclusive: the start of the next day.

follower_counts_by_association_type.description: Followers segmented by association type (empty in time-bound responses). Stored as a JSON string.

follower_counts_by_seniority.description: Followers segmented by seniority (empty in time-bound responses). Stored as a JSON string.

follower_counts_by_industry.description: Followers segmented by industry (empty in time-bound responses). Stored as a JSON string.

follower_counts_by_function.description: Followers segmented by function (empty in time-bound responses). Stored as a JSON string.

follower_counts_by_staff_count_range.alias: Follower Counts By Staff Count Range

follower_counts_by_geo_country.description: Followers segmented by country (empty in time-bound responses). Stored as a JSON string.
